sources.citation: game-design: a round nonmetallic (PVC) ceiling box of about 4 in diameter for a luminaire, a common class listed to UL 514C and described by NEMA OS 2 (cited by number). Inside taken as a cylinder of 98 mm diameter and 57 mm deep (about 3-7/8 in and 2-1/4 in), with 3 mm drawn walls; its bounding box is 104 × 104 × 60 mm (the round body inscribed in its square footprint). Unverified: no manufacturer drawing was read for this entry; electrical-realism-reviewer to check it against public dimension drawings of the class and relabel it real-world if it holds.

game-design: computed from the inside dimensions above as a plain cylinder, π × (98 / 2)² × 57 = 429949 mm³ (about 26.2 in³), rounded to a whole mm³. It is the drawn box's volume, not a marked volume and not from any code table. P4's box fill reads it.

game-design: four built-in cable clamps (knock-in tabs) a quarter-turn apart around the wall, one cable each, the box clamps the cable itself. No mount for a luminaire in P3 (P4 brings luminaires). Positions are on the round wall at its quarter points and are not taken from a product drawing.
game-design: nailed to the side of a joist or stud through its bracket (studFlange, common practice); it takes its full width along the framing member.
